data: Which of the following best describes the shape of the lines in the left plot?

The left plot shows multiple overlapping lines representing different years. The lines peak around a relative overlap value of approximately 0.01 and then decline. The lines are relatively smooth and do not show sharp peaks or valleys. The overall shape of the lines is bell-shaped, indicating a normal distribution-like pattern. Therefore, the best description of the shape of the lines in the left plot is a bell-shaped curve.
